SMTO-MEM-0026 — Knowledge's saved resource limits can't be read

GUID: f22059cc-7969-5e6b-b8b3-773eb5e86ee0
Slug: knowledge-invalid-installation-limits
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • The installation-wide limits for Knowledge, such as the maximum upload size, are saved in a file SMTO can't read or that holds values outside the allowed ranges. Uploads, indexing and searches that check these limits stop.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, saying what you were doing in Knowledge. The limits file is on the server, and only an administrator can repair it.
  2. If you manage SMTO, follow the technical fix under Technical details to correct or move aside the limits file. The Administrator resource limits form can't load or save while the saved file is unreadable.
  3. After it's fixed, open Knowledge, select Refresh, and repeat the upload or search. With a readable limits file, Knowledge can check sizes and time limits again.

What success looks like

  • Knowledge uploads and searches work again, and Administrator resource limits shows its values.

If it still fails

  • If the error continues after the file is fixed, select Copy error details again and send the new details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete SMTO's data folder or your Knowledge sources; only the limits file needs attention.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Reading the Knowledge installation limits file (limits.json in the installation's rag folder) failed because the file could not be read or did not validate against the strict Limits model (unknown key, wrong type or out-of-range value).

What this means

  • The submitted resource limits do not fit the supported Knowledge settings. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported invalid_installation_limits. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The installation settings save successfully.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Inspect installation/rag/limits.json in the SMTO state directory (next to the users folder) and correct it to valid values with no extra keys (for example max_file_bytes 1024 to 1073741824, max_threads 1 to 32), or move it aside so defaults apply. Check file permissions if it exists but cannot be read. The Administrator resource limits form cannot save until the file reads cleanly.
  • Ask an administrator to review the limits in Knowledge’s installation settings and correct the highlighted values.

Retry and execution caution

  • The installation settings save successfully.

How to verify the fix

  • The installation settings save successfully.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
